name: GENIUS
full_name: GErmanium in liquid NItrogen Underground Setup
summary: GENIUS was a large bare-germanium detector proposal for double-beta decay, dark matter and low-energy solar neutrinos. GENIUS-TF was its much smaller implemented test facility at Gran Sasso.
detection_principle: Unencapsulated high-purity germanium detectors operate directly in ultra-clean liquid nitrogen to reduce nearby radioactive materials. The tonne-scale enriched-isotope concept and the natural-germanium test facility have different capabilities.

status.label: Multiple stages
status.evidence: Four bare germanium detectors were installed in liquid nitrogen on 5 May 2003 in GENIUS-TF. This prototype operation is not evidence that the full proposed GENIUS array was built.

science_scope: A neutrinoless decay would violate lepton number. Half-life sensitivity is a forecast unless explicitly reported as an experimental limit; its interpretation as an effective Majorana mass depends on the decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements.
